facts.text: The hotel is on Chiromo Lane in Westlands, Nairobi.
facts.excerpt: Chiromo Lane, Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya

facts.text: The hotel rises 35 stories above the Westlands district.
facts.excerpt: JW Marriott Hotel Nairobi rises 35 stories above the vibrant Westlands district

facts.text: The hotel is the tallest hotel in Kenya.
facts.excerpt: As the tallest hotel in Kenya, it boasts panoramic views and seamless access via the Nairobi Expressway

facts.text: A heated infinity pool sits on the fifth floor, with skyline views and private cabanas.
facts.excerpt: Discover a tranquil sanctuary on the fifth floor, where our heated infinity pool invites you to unwind against a backdrop of stunning skyline views. Lounge in the comfort of a private cabana

facts.text: Spa by JW has eight treatment rooms, a relaxation lounge, a steam room and a sauna.
facts.excerpt: Complete with eight treatment rooms, a relaxation lounge, steam room, sauna and a heated infinity pool

facts.text: The hotel displays genuine African artwork that guests can buy.
facts.excerpt: The hotel features a carefully arranged selection of genuine African artwork, chosen to highlight the region

facts.text: The artwork pieces are available for purchase.
facts.excerpt: These pieces are not merely decorative, they are available for purchase

facts.text: Rooms and residences have large windows with views of the Central Business District and the Westlands entertainment hub.
facts.excerpt: All rooms and residences provide a spacious atmosphere with large windows offering views of the Central Business District and Westlands entertainment hub.

facts.text: Every guest room has a walk-in shower and a bathtub.
facts.excerpt: Unwind in style with a spacious walk-in shower and high-end bathtub in every guest room

facts.text: Rooms and residences have electric sheers and curtains.
facts.excerpt: Electric sheers and curtains, and walk-in showers and high-quality bathtubs add to the convenience and sophistication.

facts.text: The JW Marriott Residences have fully equipped kitchens and separate living and dining areas.
facts.excerpt: Featuring fully equipped kitchens, separate living and dining areas, guests staying in our residences can enjoy all the facilities and services of the hotel

facts.text: Residences come in one-, two- or three-bedroom layouts.
facts.excerpt: The spacious one-, two-, or three-bedroom layouts are perfect for both short and extended stays for business or leisure.

facts.text: Interiors are inspired by local culture and landscapes.
facts.excerpt: With modern architecture and elegant interiors inspired by local culture and landscapes

facts.text: The Presidential Suite blends contemporary African design with modern elegance and has sweeping city views.
facts.excerpt: Meticulously appointed interiors blend contemporary African design with modern elegance

facts.text: Club Room and Suite guests have access to the Executive Lounge, with food and drinks served throughout the day.
facts.excerpt: Club Room and Suite guests enjoy this exclusive space with a curated selection of culinary and beverage offerings served throughout the day.

facts.text: Mr. Pang Sky Bar and Lounge serves Pan-Asian food and signature drinks with views.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your evening at Mr. Pang...See More Sky Bar & Lounge with bold Pan-Asian flavors, signature drinks, and breathtaking views.

facts.text: Mughal serves Mughlai Indian cuisine from an open kitchen.
facts.excerpt: This refined Indian restaurant in Nairobi brings authentic Mughlai flavors to life in an open kitchen and bar setting.

facts.text: Myna serves international cuisine and has an outdoor terrace.
facts.excerpt: Delight in a uniquely crafted experience at this Nairobi restaurant with international cuisine and an outdoor terrace.

facts.text: The 24-hour fitness center on the fifth floor has floor-to-ceiling windows with city views.
facts.excerpt: Framed by floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic city views, the environment inspires both mindfulness and movement. Open 24 hours

facts.text: The Nairobi National Museum is a short walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the Nairobi National Museum, a short walk from our hotel

facts.text: The hotel is about 20 minutes from Jomo Kenyatta International Airport via the Nairobi Expressway.
facts.excerpt: seamless access via the Nairobi Expressway, just 20 minutes from the Jomo Kenyatta International Airport

facts.text: The hotel offers curated city tours, including Nairobi National Park and the Karen Blixen Museum.
facts.excerpt: From the untamed beauty of Nairobi National Park to the charm of the Karen Blixen Museum, and immersive art

facts.text: Nearby Nairobi National Park offers game drives with city skyscrapers as a backdrop.
facts.excerpt: Nearby Nairobi National Park offers game drives with a backdrop of the city skyscrapers.

facts.text: The Pool Bar serves light meals, snacks and cocktails, with sunsets over the Nairobi cityscape.
facts.excerpt: The Pool Bar offers refreshing beverages and light bites in a serene atmosphere with stunning sunsets over the Nairobi cityscape.

facts.text: The hotel is Green Key certified.
facts.excerpt: The Green Key Certified

facts.text: Self parking and valet parking are complimentary for guests.
facts.excerpt: Self parking is complimentary for guests. Valet parking is complimentary for guests.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at JW Marriott Hotel Nairobi.

facts.text: Mr. Pang and Mughal have a dress code that excludes shorts, sneakers, flip-flops and sportswear.
facts.excerpt: No shorts, sneakers, flip-flops, or sportswear.
